items.heading: Romazava
details: Key ingredients: beef, leafy greens, ginger, tomato
Simmer beef with ginger and onion until tender.
Add a mix of leafy greens and tomato.
Cook until the greens are soft and the broth is fragrant.
Serve the stew over rice, the island's staple.

items.heading: Ravitoto
details: Key ingredients: cassava leaves, pork, garlic
Pound cassava leaves finely.
Simmer the leaves for a long time with pork and garlic.
Cook until the pork is tender and the leaves are dark and soft.
Serve hot over rice.
